# Scratch-repository git commits in a _test.go whose own function sets neither
# an author nor a committer on the command, and does not set local user.name
# and user.email itself. One file:function per line
# (internal/ci/git_identity_class_test.go). Each row below is a commit that
# continues a repository an earlier function already configured, so the commit
# does not read the runner's global git config; the scanner does not follow
# that identity across functions. That is what blocks "every test". This list
# only shrinks. A row is `file:function <why it is judged not a bare commit>`.
# ceiling: 5
